body: New cmd/promptoverse-thumbnails, systemd timer every 15min, idempotent ImageMagick convert per node. Renderer + live JS both prefer thumb/optimized with fallback to original. Live-verified: manual run processed all 103 nodes (real size reduction ~87-98%), then the timer's first automatic fire correctly picked up only the 2 new nodes since. 4 new tests. Commit a2692e4.
title: Prompt-o-verse: cron-driven thumbnails + optimized images live
